notes.title: 2024.06.28 Update
notes.notes:
Fixed the problem that the archive location may randomly appear in two locations and cause the archive to not be read.
Newly added vertical paintings and opening and ending CGs have been added to the gallery.

Since the archives of different versions are currently not interoperable,
After the update, we will put the completely broken archive in the third location of the archive.
Players who are completely broken can view the gallery there.
